title: GraspBench: Execution-Aware Cross-Robot Evaluation of 6-DoF Grasp Generation in MuJoCo
abstract: arXiv:2611.07651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern 6-DoF grasp generators are often evaluated using grasp scores, dataset-level metrics, or single-robot demonstrations, yet proposal quality alone does not determine whether a grasp is executable by a particular robot. We present GraspBench, a controlled MuJoCo protocol for evaluating complete grasp-generation pipelines after robot-specific inverse-kinematics filtering, motion planning, and fixed approach-close-lift execution. GraspBench evaluates six configured pipelines across four robot embodiments, five diagnostic objects, and a structured tabletop pose grid, yielding 540 scenarios per method and 3,240 method-scenario evaluations in total. Missing outputs are conservatively counted as failures, and success follows the binary lift criterion produced by each method's execution runner. translated_title: GraspBench：MuJoCo中面向执行感知的6自由度抓取生成跨机器人评估
translated_abstract: 现代6自由度（6-DoF）抓取生成器通常使用抓取分数、数据集级指标或单机器人演示进行评估，然而仅有抓取提案的质量并不能决定该抓取能否被特定机器人真正执行。我们提出GraspBench，这是一个基于MuJoCo的受控评估协议，用于在经过机器人特定的逆运动学过滤、运动规划以及固定的“接近-闭合-提升”执行流程之后，对完整的抓取生成流水线进行端到端评估。GraspBench在四种机器人本体、五个诊断物体和一个结构化的桌面姿态网格上评估了六种配置的流水线，每种方法产生540个场景，总计3,240次方法-场景评估。缺失的输出被保守地计为失败，成功与否由各方法自身的执行器按二元提升准则判定。结果显示，GraspGen取得了最高的总体成功率（73.1%），其次是EconomicGrasp（63.5%），而基于机器人和物体条件的分析进一步揭示了……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: GraspBench是一个在MuJoCo中对6自由度抓取生成流水线进行端到端可执行性评估的跨机器人基准，通过逆运动学过滤、运动规划和固定执行流程，在四种机器人本体和多个物体上系统比较了六种方法，发现GraspGen以73.1%的成功率居首。
en_tdlr: GraspBench is an execution-aware, MuJoCo-based benchmark that evaluates complete 6-DoF grasp generation pipelines end-to-end across four robot embodiments and multiple objects, revealing GraspGen as the top performer with a 73.1% overall success rate.
